title: Faster Elimination
statementMd:
**This is the hard version of the problem. The only difference between the versions is the range of 𝑛n.**

Colin likes to play the Happy Eliminate game to kill time. Usually, the player is asked to find a fixed pattern in the given content, then eliminate it. The variety of patterns makes the game rich and exciting.

To research which pattern makes the game most exciting, Colin built a model: The contents given to the user are represented as a string 𝑠s, and the pattern is another string 𝑡t. In each turn of the game, the user can do one of the following two operations, and the game will be kept going until 𝑡t becomes empty:

- Delete the last character of the pattern 𝑡t.
- Find a substring of 𝑠s that is equal to 𝑡t, say 𝑠[𝑖,𝑗]=𝑡s[i,j]=t, then delete several characters in the prefix of 𝑠s until 𝑠[𝑖+1]s[i+1], i.e., (make 𝑠s become 𝑠[𝑖+1,|𝑠|]s[i+1,|s|]), and then delete the last character of the pattern 𝑡t.

Colin defines a game's excitement as the maximum number of times the second operation can be performed. He wants to find the best pattern to maximize excitement, but he has no idea how to construct it. Thus, he turned it over to you, the top player of Happy Eliminate.

Recall that |𝑠||s| represents the length of the string 𝑠s, and 𝑠[𝑖,𝑗]s[i,j] represents the substring of the string 𝑠s, starting from the 𝑖i-th character to the 𝑗j-th character (including the 𝑖i-th and the 𝑗j-th).

## Input

The first line contains a single integer 𝑇T, representing the number of test cases.

For each test case:

The first line contains a single integer 𝑛 (1≤𝑛≤5×105)n (1≤n≤5×105), representing the length of the string 𝑠s.

The second line contains a string 𝑠s, consisting only of lowercase letters.

It's guaranteed that the sum of 𝑛n is not larger than 5×1055×105.

## Output

For each test case, output a single line with a single integer, representing the maximum possible excitement.

## Note

For the first sample, you can choose 𝑡t as 𝑎𝑏𝑐abc.

For the second sample, you can choose 𝑡t as 𝑎𝑎𝑎𝑎aaaa.

For the third sample, you can choose 𝑡t as 𝑎𝑏𝑎aba.
statementZhMd:
**这是本题的困难版本。两个版本的唯一区别在于 𝑛n 的范围。**

Colin 喜欢玩开心消消乐来打发时间。通常，玩家需要在给定的内容中找到某个固定的模式，然后将其消除。丰富多样的模式让游戏充满趣味与刺激。

为了研究哪种模式能让游戏最刺激，Colin 建立了一个模型：提供给玩家的内容用字符串 𝑠s 表示，模式则是另一个字符串 𝑡t。在游戏的每一轮中，玩家可以执行以下两种操作之一，直到 𝑡t 变为空串，游戏结束：

- 删除模式 𝑡t 的最后一个字符。
- 在 𝑠s 中找到一个等于 𝑡t 的子串，记为 𝑠[𝑖,𝑗]=𝑡s[i,j]=t，然后删除 𝑠s 开头的若干个字符，使其从 𝑠[𝑖+1]s[i+1] 开始，即使 𝑠s 变为 𝑠[𝑖+1,|𝑠|]s[i+1,|s|]，接着删除模式 𝑡t 的最后一个字符。

Colin 将一局游戏的刺激程度定义为第二种操作最多可以执行的次数。他想找到一个最佳模式，使刺激程度最大，但他不知道该如何构造。因此，他将这个任务交给了身为开心消消乐顶尖玩家的你。

回顾一下，|𝑠||s| 表示字符串 𝑠s 的长度，𝑠[𝑖,𝑗]s[i,j] 表示字符串 𝑠s 中从第 𝑖i 个字符到第 𝑗j 个字符的子串（包含第 𝑖i 个和第 𝑗j 个字符）。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 𝑇T，表示测试用例的数量。

对于每个测试用例：

第一行包含一个整数 𝑛 (1≤𝑛≤5×105)n (1≤n≤5×105)，表示字符串 𝑠s 的长度。

第二行包含一个字符串 𝑠s，仅由小写字母组成。

保证所有测试用例的 𝑛n 之和不超过 5×1055×105。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一行，包含一个整数，表示可能达到的最大刺激程度。

## 说明

对于第一个样例，可以选择 𝑡t 为 𝑎𝑏𝑐abc。

对于第二个样例，可以选择 𝑡t 为 𝑎𝑎𝑎𝑎aaaa。

对于第三个样例，可以选择 𝑡t 为 𝑎𝑏𝑎aba。
